name: Mesh Voxelization
definition: A technique to convert a 3D mesh model in .stl format into voxel center coordinates, sharing the same output export and preview mechanisms as point cloud voxelization.
summary: Mesh Voxelization converts polygon meshes into discrete voxel grids using ray casting to robustly determine inside-outside status, handling complex concavities better than bounding box or template methods.
